mechanisms.statement: The incompressible kinetic energy E_i at equilibration scales with quench duration as E_i proportional to tau_Q^{-(1+2 nu)/(1+z nu)}, with mean-field exponents nu=1/2 and z=2 giving E_i proportional to tau_Q^{-1}.

paper_scope: The paper studies spontaneous quantum turbulence (SQT) in a 2D Bose-Einstein condensate formed by a thermal quench, using stochastic projected Gross-Pitaevskii simulations. It establishes Kibble-Zurek scaling of vortex number and equilibration time, Kolmogorov scaling of the incompressible kinetic energy spectrum, and universal collapse of the incompressible kinetic energy E_i with quench duration tau_Q at two temperatures.
